behavioral_trends.finding: High sensitivity to lesson lengths (>10m causes dropouts). 90%+ enthusiastic about streaks, badges, and instant gratification loops.

behavioral_trends.group: Mastery & Career Learners (Deep Learner, Career Switcher)
behavioral_trends.finding: Indifferent or adverse to cartoon gamification; highly motivated by portfolio tasks, instructor credentials, and verified certifications.
Extremely price-sensitive (prefer ad-supported freemium); quickly churn if academic pressure or guilt is applied.

top_insights: CRITICAL DROPOUT FACTOR: 4 out of 5 personas report lesson duration exceeding 15 minutes as the #1 reason for quitting a course.
POLARIZING FEATURE: Leaderboards and XP systems increase engagement for competitive learners but alienate analytical/deep learners.
PRICING MODEL GAP: Impulse learners prefer low one-time course fees (Udemy style), whereas career switchers and deep learners prefer outcome-oriented memberships.
HIGH RETENTION LEVER: Combining Duolingo-style 5-minute daily micro-habits with structured Udemy-style skill progression is strongly validated.

per_persona_breakdown.name: Rohan Mehta
per_persona_breakdown.key_takeaway: Prefers under 10 minutes | Dropout trigger: dense theory and lack of early wins | Stance: one-time course discount purchase

per_persona_breakdown.name: Chloe Martin
per_persona_breakdown.key_takeaway: Prefers 3-7 minutes | Dropout trigger: losing streak or punitive difficulty curve | Stance: small monthly sub if streak freeze is included

per_persona_breakdown.name: Aarav Deshmukh
per_persona_breakdown.key_takeaway: Prefers 20-40 minutes with comprehensive notes | Dropout trigger: gimmicky features, shallow summaries, unvetted instructors | Stance: willing to pay annual fee for high-quality library

per_persona_breakdown.name: David Kim
per_persona_breakdown.key_takeaway: Prefers 10-15 minutes with portfolio projects | Dropout trigger: outdated tech stack, lack of verified credentials | Stance: outcome-based subscription or company reimbursement

per_persona_breakdown.name: Mateo Rossi
per_persona_breakdown.key_takeaway: Prefers under 5 minutes | Dropout trigger: quizzes with harsh fail states or mandatory homework | Stance: freemium with ads, will rarely pay
